trails.note: The Heaven's Road diagonal turns down at ~(712,1022) into a cut along the east edge of Stateside Glade, bounded on the right by an evergreen band that separates it from the Northway/Paradise Meadows cut. It bends down-left past the square (654,1183), then takes the right-hand opening between two tree islands down-right to join Paradise Meadows at ~(724,1314). Unsure exactly where Heaven's Road ends and Sweetheart begins (anywhere from y~1020 to ~1130). A parallel opening on the left (x~600-630, y 1240-1310) is not included.

Leaves the Montrealer ridge at ~(640,502), runs down the cut on the right (east) side of the tree island where the upper diamond (666,596) sits, then the S-curve down-left through the lower diamond (611,857). Ends where it opens into the Heaven's Road diagonal at ~(614,946), which carries Heaven's Road's own label. The unlabeled left-hand loop around the tree island (x~565-600, y~560-690) is not included.

Open ridge-top cut just below the boundary line (the uphill-route dashes run along it); the square at (713,514) sits on it. Traced from the Jet Triple Chair summit (~505,468) east along the ridge to the saddle (~1035,572) where Northway drops away and Catwalk/Vermonter meet. No other label on this ridge band.

Both squares, (816,1084) and (733,1296), sit on the cut that the magenta uphill route runs up. Starts at the upper square, where the Northway cut and the Hell's Crossing band (which has the Hell's Crossing label at (944,980)) merge. Follows the centre of the cut down past the lower square to the Stateside/Bonaventure Quad base at ~(690,1425). The magenta line hugs the cut's left side, so the trace sits about 10 px right of it. Upper start not certain: it could begin a little higher up the Hell's Crossing band.

Followed the dotted slow-zone corridor, which is plain on a dot-density map. It starts at the Village Double Chair top hub (~1195,1512) and runs down-left in a strip below the Shakedown hardwood band to (885,1598). It then drops at x~870, turns west at y~1668, and goes down past the circle (766,1701) through the village. After a hairpin at ~(658,1845) it runs down-right to the Village Double Chair base (~885,2064). The upper diagonal strip has no label of its own; it counts as Grammy Jay only because it connects straight into the labelled corridor.

Beginner area served by the Stateside moving carpet (bottom ~(680,1557), top ~(777,1534)). The symbol (752,1562) sits just below the carpet in a small dotted open patch; the label text runs right over hardwoods. Traced as the short slope beside the carpet, from its top down to its bottom station. That dotted patch does not connect to the Grammy Jay corridor to the east.

Green trail in the slow zone (dots cover it, so the snow was read with the dots masked out). The label sits in a dotted snow strip between the lower ends of the Bonaventure/Show-off glades and the Bonaventure Quad line. Traced from where that strip pinches out against the lift line at ~(1128,1220), along the strip through the label, then down-left through a narrow gap between the evergreen band and a hardwood strip to the Paradise Meadows cut at ~(762,1293). Its upper end is uncertain: it might carry on under the lift toward Lower Can Am.

Wide dotted corridor along the Village Double Chair, with the circle (1067,1820) inside it on the lift's right side. Traced about 12 px right of the lift line (the corridor centre) from the chair's top terminal hub (~1246,1488) to its bottom terminal (~895,2058).
